01 / About

Who I am

I'm a Computer Science student at Assiut University (class of 2027, GPA 3.52) who likes turning messy data into systems that actually work. I move between machine learning, NLP and data engineering, from LangGraph multi-agent apps to SQL Server warehouses, and I learn best by building and shipping.

The past year has been hands-on: AI engineering at Lothgha, ML training at FlyRank AI, data and analytics at Ejada, banking and finance at CIB, the 9-month IBM Data Scientist track with DEPI, plus Python and databases at ITI and network security at NTI.

Beyond internships, I contribute to open source (two merged PRs in pgmpy, shipped in v1.1.1), help run bootcamps with 700+ people at GDG on Campus Hurghada, share notebooks on Kaggle, and write resumes for clients as a freelancer. Right now I'm studying data science and ML with the Matsuo-Iwasawa Lab at the University of Tokyo through GCI World.
